description: Records a trade the user agreed to: pass the dealId from check_trade (preferred; then list each card's confirmed value in the same order) or the cards themselves, the value the user confirmed for EVERY line (the total for that line's quantity), and any cash in or out. An outgoing card bought through Deal Desk can be given by its purchase dealId. Show the user every value and the cash and pass confirm true after they confirm or edit each one. Outgoing cards leave the collection at their value; incoming cards join it with their value as cost (slab certNumber when visible). All or nothing: if one card can't be recorded nothing is, and the message names it. Trade values are estimates, kept apart from cash profit. If the result has alerts, show them to the user before anything else.

cashIn.description: Cash the user received in USD.

cashOut.description: Cash the user paid in USD.

confirm.description: True once the user said yes to every value and the cash; never set it before that.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique key for this record (any short text you make up once); a retry with the same key never records twice.

cardId.description: SlabLineage card id from search_cards (any row of the card). Give cardId or the catalog id; one of them is required.

certNumber.description: The cert number on the slab label, when visible.

grade.description: The grade on the slab label, e.g. "10" or "9.5". Not needed for RAW.

grader.description: The slab's grading company read off the label: PSA, TAG, CGC, BGS (Beckett), SGC, ACE or another; RAW for an ungraded card.

scrydexCardId.description: Or the card's catalog id, e.g. "sv3pt5-199" (when you have it instead of cardId).

value.description: The value the user confirmed for this line in USD: the TOTAL for its quantity, not per card.
